brief:
Israeli police blocked a graduation ceremony for Jerusalem University students on Monday and detained multiple students and academics, Shehab Wire reported. The officers stormed Khan Tankiz in the Qattan Market area near where the event was taking place. The Palestinian Jerusalem Governorate confirmed the raid in an official statement.

The disruption occurred as Palestinian educational institutions continue to face restrictions and interference from Israeli security forces in the occupied city. Graduation ceremonies and student gatherings have become flashpoints for confrontation in Jerusalem, where Israeli authorities exercise control over public assembly and movement in Palestinian areas.
